name: sumi
description: UX/UI design mastery plugin — 22 skills, 22 commands across 6 numbered phases (GROUND → DISCOVER → DIAGNOSE → FORTIFY → BUILD → LAUNCH). Each command carries a phase.step address (0.1–5.3) grounded in NNG methodology and visual design process. Phase Position headers guide users through the 22-step journey. Dual UX + commercial milestones per phase. Commands: /guide, /ground (0.1), /intent (0.2), /taste (1.1), /inspo (1.2), /benchmark (1.3), /pulse (1.4), /vibe-check (2.1), /brain-scan (2.2), /include (2.3), /flow (2.4), /dark-scan (3.1), /trust-scan (3.2), /copy-check (3.3), /responsive (3.4), /drip (4.1), /screen (4.2), /ship (4.3), /onboard (4.4), /extract (4.5), /roast (5.1), /remix (5.2), /judge (5.3). Covers NNG design thinking process, heuristics, cognitive psychology, production code (React/SwiftUI/CSS), Figma MCP, accessibility (WCAG 2.2+3.0), mobile/desktop/web, motion, AI/spatial/voice UX, design systems, and 20+ industry verticals.
